mapper.select: SELECT t.other_id AS userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, m.content AS lastMessage, m.create_time AS lastTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE from_user_id = t.other_id AND to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END AS other_id, MAX(id) AS last_id FROM message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END ) t JOIN message m ON m.id = t.last_id JOIN `user` u ON u.id = t.other_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
